1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

<script>
(()=>{
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const overlay=$('overlay'),startBtn=$('startBtn'),scoreEl=$('score'),bestEl=$('bestHeader');
let W=960,H=600,dpr=1,last=0,elapsed=0,score=0,best=Number(localStorage.getItem('lumenBest')||0),hull=100,streak=1,streakTimer=0,dash=0,dashCooldown=0,invuln=0,spawnTimer=0,pickupTimer=0,shake=0;
let state='ready',soundOn=true,audio=null;
const keys={},touch={up:false,down:false,left:false,right:false,dash:false};
let player={x:480,y:300,vx:0,vy:0,r:10};
let enemies=[],orbs=[],particles=[],stars=[];
bestEl.textContent=String(best).padStart(4,'0');
function resize(){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.floor(r.width*dpr));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.floor(r.height*dpr));ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);W=r.width;H=r.height;if(!stars.length)stars=Array.from({length:105},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,z:.2+Math.random()*.8,p:Math.random()*6.28}));}
new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas);resize();
function sound(freq=560,dur=.08,wave='sine',vol=.025){if(!soundOn)return;try{audio ||= new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(audio.state==='suspended')audio.resume();const o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain();o.type=wave;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,audio.currentTime);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(60,freq*.62),audio.currentTime+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,audio.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,audio.currentTime+dur);o.connect(g);g.connect(audio.destination);o.start();o.stop(audio.currentTime+dur);}catch{}}
function setState(next){state=next;$('statusLabel').textContent=next==='running'?'IN THE FIELD':next.toUpperCase();$('pauseBtn').style.opacity=next==='running'||next==='paused'?'1':'.45';}
function start(){if(state==='running')return;reset();setState('running');overlay.classList.add('hidden');last=performance.now();sound(520,.12);}
function reset(){elapsed=0;score=0;hull=100;streak=1;streakTimer=0;dash=0;dashCooldown=0;invuln=0;spawnTimer=.8;pickupTimer=.5;enemies=[];orbs=[];particles=[];player={x:W*.5,y:H*.58,vx:0,vy:0,r:10};updateUI();}
function pause(){if(state==='running'){setState('paused');$('overlayKicker').textContent='TAKE A BREATH';$('overlayTitle').textContent='Hold the quiet';$('overlayCopy').textContent='Your light is safe here. Ready when you are.';startBtn.textContent='Resume run';overlay.classList.remove('hidden');}else if(state==='paused'){setState('running');overlay.classList.add('hidden');last=performance.now();}}
function gameOver(){setState('complete');overlay.classList.remove('hidden');$('overlayKicker').textContent='FIELD NOTE COMPLETE';$('overlayTitle').textContent=score>best?'A new little record':'The dark can wait';$('overlayCopy').textContent=`You gathered ${score} light${score===1?'':'s'} in ${formatTime(elapsed)}. ${score>best?'Your brightest run yet.':''}`;startBtn.textContent='Run it again';if(score>best){best=score;localStorage.setItem('lumenBest',best);bestEl.textContent=String(best).padStart(4,'0');}sound(170,.35,'triangle',.04);}
function formatTime(n){return`${Math.floor(n/60)}:${String(Math.floor(n%60)).padStart(2,'0')}`}
function updateUI(){scoreEl.textContent=String(score).padStart(4,'0');$('hullText').textContent=`${Math.max(0,Math.ceil(hull))}%`;$('hullBar').style.width=`${Math.max(0,hull)}%`;$('dashText').textContent=dashCooldown<=0?'READY':`${Math.ceil(dashCooldown)}s`;$('dashBar').style.width=`${Math.max(0,100-dashCooldown/3.2*100)}%`;$('streak').textContent=`×${streak}`;$('time').textContent=formatTime(elapsed);}
function burst(x,y,color,n=8){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,s=25+Math.random()*115;particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:.35+Math.random()*.45,max:.8,r:1+Math.random()*2,color});}}
function addOrb(x=Math.random()*(W-60)+30,y=Math.random()*(H-60)+30){orbs.push({x,y,r:5,p:Math.random()*6.28});}
function addEnemy(){const side=Math.floor(Math.random()*4);let x=side===0?-14:side===1?W+14:Math.random()*W,y=side===2?-14:side===3?H+14:Math.random()*H;const dx=player.x-x,dy=player.y-y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<Math.min(W,H)*.35){addEnemy();return}enemies.push({x,y,r:9+Math.random()*3,speed:30+Math.min(28,elapsed*.42),phase:Math.random()*6.28});}
function collect(orb){score+=streak*10;streak=Math.min(9,streak+1);streakTimer=2.3;burst(orb.x,orb.y,'#ffdf91',11);sound(540+streak*60,.09,'sine',.018);}
function hit(enemy){if(invuln>0||dash>0)return;hull-=25;invuln=1.2;shake=9;streak=1;streakTimer=0;burst(player.x,player.y,'#ff829f',18);sound(130,.23,'sawtooth',.04);const dx=player.x-enemy.x,dy=player.y-enemy.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;player.vx+=dx/d*220;player.vy+=dy/d*220;if(hull<=0){hull=0;updateUI();gameOver();}}
function update(dt){if(state!=='running')return;elapsed+=dt;dashCooldown=Math.max(0,dashCooldown-dt);dash=Math.max(0,dash-dt);invuln=Math.max(0,invuln-dt);streakTimer-=dt;if(streakTimer<=0)streak=1;const ix=(keys.ArrowRight||keys.d||touch.right?1:0)-(keys.ArrowLeft||keys.a||touch.left?1:0),iy=(keys.ArrowDown||keys.s||touch.down?1:0)-(keys.ArrowUp||keys.w||touch.up?1:0);let dx=ix,dy=iy,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(len){dx/=len;dy/=len}if((keys[' ']||touch.dash)&&dashCooldown<=0){dash=.22;dashCooldown=3.2;player.vx=dx*500+(dx===0?player.vx:0);player.vy=dy*500+(dy===0?player.vy:0);invuln=Math.max(invuln,.3);sound(260,.16,'triangle',.035);burst(player.x,player.y,'#8faaff',9);keys[' ']=false;touch.dash=false;}const speed=dash>0?500:210;player.vx+=(dx*speed-player.vx)*Math.min(1,dt*(dash>0?8:9));player.vy+=(dy*speed-player.vy)*Math.min(1,dt*(dash>0?8:9));player.x+=player.vx*dt;player.y+=player.vy*dt;player.x=Math.max(13,Math.min(W-13,player.x));player.y=Math.max(13,Math.min(H-13,player.y));
spawnTimer-=dt;if(spawnTimer<=0){addEnemy();spawnTimer=Math.max(.56,2.1-elapsed*.012)*(.75+Math.random()*.5);}pickupTimer-=dt;if(pickupTimer<=0){if(orbs.length<6)addOrb();pickupTimer=1.3+Math.random()*1.1;}
for(const e of enemies){const vx=player.x-e.x,vy=player.y-e.y,d=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1;e.x+=vx/d*e.speed*dt;e.y+=vy/d*e.speed*dt;e.phase+=dt*2.2;if(Math.hypot(player.x-e.x,player.y-e.y)<player.r+e.r)hit(e);}enemies=enemies.filter(e=>e.x>-35&&e.x<W+35&&e.y>-35&&e.y<H+35);
for(let i=orbs.length-1;i>=0;i--){const o=orbs[i];o.p+=dt*2;if(Math.hypot(player.x-o.x,player.y-o.y)<player.r+o.r+5){collect(o);orbs.splice(i,1);}}
for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){const p=particles[i];p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vx*=Math.pow(.08,dt);p.vy*=Math.pow(.08,dt);p.life-=dt;if(p.life<=0)particles.splice(i,1);}shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*28);updateUI();}

Built **Lumen Run**, a complete browser arcade game in `index.html`. Steer your light, collect gold motes to build a score streak, dash through danger, and survive the pursuing shades. Your best score is saved locally.

**Controls:** WASD or arrow keys to move, Space to dash, P or Escape to pause. Touch controls are included for mobile.

I assumed a small survival arcade game since no specific game concept was provided. I checked the game in desktop and mobile browser viewports and verified the JavaScript syntax and browser console.
